title: Git, Pull Requests, and Useful Documentation Quick Check

questions.prompt: What does the Git staging area select?
questions.explanation: Staging is an explicit boundary between working-tree changes and the snapshot about to be committed.

questions.prompt: Select information a useful pull request description should contain.
questions.explanation: A reviewer needs intent, evidence, and risk to evaluate the change efficiently.

questions.prompt: A Git branch is primarily a movable name pointing to a commit.
questions.explanation: Branches are lightweight references that advance as new commits are recorded.
